lines.text: Many learners say: I will see you on monday.
Better: I will see you on Monday.
Days start with a big letter.
On Monday! Days start with a big letter.

data.wrong: I will see you on monday.
data.right: I will see you on Monday.
data.why: Days start with a big letter.

native.tip: En español los días y los meses van en minúscula, pero en inglés empiezan con mayúscula: “Monday”, “June.”
native.caption: Muchos escriben “I will see you on monday.” 🙈 En español los días y los meses se escriben en minúscula, pero en inglés empiezan con mayúscula: “I will see you on Monday.” ¡Mira a Ama y practica! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.tip: Spanish writes days and months in lowercase, but English starts them with a capital: “Monday”, “June.”
en.caption: Many learners write “I will see you on monday.” Spanish writes days and months in lowercase, but English starts them with a capital letter: “I will see you on Monday.” Watch Ama and practice! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
